en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a large group of people, many dressed in traditional folk costumes, standing in front of a grand wooden building with ornate architectural details, including a balcony and decorative trim. The group appears to be participating in a traditional circle dance, suggesting a local festivity or celebration. Handwritten text in French is visible at the bottom, along with a green postage stamp marked with '5 BANI' and a date stamp.
